title: The Borders of the Land of Canaan
description: The Lord gives Moses a detailed description of the borders of the land of Canaan that are to be given as an inheritance to the Israelites. The southern border runs from the Desert of Sin along Edom, past the Salt Sea, the Scorpion Pass, and Kadesh-Barnea to the Brook of Egypt. The western border is the Great Sea. The northern border runs from the Great Sea via Mount Hor to Lebo-Hamat and Hazar-Enan. The eastern border runs from Hazar-Enan through Riblah and the Sea of Kinnereth down along the Jordan to the Salt Sea.
